## Placeholder — not a finished chapter
Later official chronology and current program pages are now catalogued. This page still does not write the post-pilot narrative (Issue #5).

## What this chapter is for

Later work can track how CSIL changed after a design/pilot period: eligibility, administration, reviews, and public documentation. This chapter should stay source-led and should not become a policy-recommendation page.

## Evidence status

- **Later official chronology:** [Ombudsperson 2012](../sources/2012-ombudsperson-best-of-care.qmd) states province-wide implementation in 1995 and cites a November 2008 CSIL Program Review (also referring to a 2007 provincial review).
- **Inspected later review (link only):** [CSIL Program Review Synthesis Report](../sources/2008-program-review-synthesis.qmd) (James Murtagh Consulting for Home and Community Care Branch, November 2008; Internet Archive Microlog fiche). Cover title matches the Ombudsperson short title; the cover subtitle is “Synthesis Report.” The report dates CSIL to “the 1990's” and does not choose 1993 versus 1994.
- **Current program documentation (not founding records):** [gov.bc.ca CSIL page](../sources/gov-bc-csil-program-page.qmd); [HCC Policy 4.C](../sources/hcc-policy-manual-4c.qmd); [VCH CSIL page](../sources/vch-csil-service-page.qmd).
- **Open questions:** 2007 versus November 2008 review products; administrative homes after the mid-1990s; whether ECPM survived as a VCH name (no current public hit).
